title: Picomve's portfolio app
description: A basic PWA web application to showcase my skills and projects
details:
## Project Overview

I developed this high-performance, responsive **Progressive Web App (PWA)** using Next.js to effectively showcase my full-stack development skills and featured projects.

## Key Features

- **Responsive Design** - Works seamlessly across all devices
- **PWA Capabilities** - Offline support and fast loading times
- **SEO Optimized** - Built-in search engine optimization
- **Modern Architecture** - Clean, modular codebase

## Technical Stack

The application leverages modern web standards including:

1. Next.js for server-side rendering
2. React for dynamic UI components
3. TypeScript for type safety
4. Tailwind CSS for styling
5. Node.js backend services

## Impact

This project serves as a living portfolio of my technical journey and demonstrates my commitment to delivering user-centric digital solutions with polished UI/UX design.
